When is that deadline in my local time? You may reason briefly, but end your reply with one final line exactly in this format: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

Let me work through this step by step:

- Today is Saturday, October 24, 2026
- Submissions close six days from today, which is Friday, October 30, 2026
- The deadline is Friday, October 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT (Pacific Time)

Spain (Madrid) is in the Central European Time (CET/CEST) zone. In October 2026, Spain will be on CET (UTC+1), while Pacific Time will be PST (UTC-8).

The time difference is 9 hours (CET is 9 hours ahead of PST).

11:59 PM PT = 11:59 PM + 9 hours = 8:59 AM the next day in Madrid

So the deadline in Madrid time is Saturday, October 31, 2026 at 8:59 AM.

ANSWER: 2026-10-31 08:59
